svg.title: FIG-03 当前配置与原子生成 FIG-03 Current configuration and generation
svg.desc: 一份 authored TOML one authored TOML assembly; SoC / CPU / routes 事实 SoC / CPU / route facts; Board 接线与来源事实 Board wiring and provenance; 严格解析：字段、模式、资源、输入身份 strict field / mode / resource / identity checks; 不可变 typed IR immutable typed IR; 事务生成与原子发布 transactional generation and atomic publish; 静态实例 / factory / 配置 / 内存预算 static instances / factory / config / budgets; CMake：唯一软件目标图 CMake: sole software target graph; Ninja：编译、链接、资源检查 Ninja: compile / link / resource checks; ELF / BIN / map / 资源报告 ELF / BIN / map / resource reports; 拒绝 / 生成失败 rejected input or generation failure; owned bundle 失效，不暴露半成品 invalidate owned bundle, no partial outputs; 产品选择 product selection; 芯片能力 silicon capability; Board 授权 Board authorization; 验证通过 validated; 生成选定内容 generate selected content; 成功发布 atomic publish; 配置与生成源 configuration and generated sources; 执行目标图 execute target graph; 本次实际产物 actual artifacts of this execution; 非法 / 冲突 / 变化 invalid / conflict / input changed; 生成或发布失败 generation or publish failure; 仅清理拥有的输出 invalidate owned outputs only
